narrative.overview: The site is a child of the Cilica app's design system, which stays authoritative; tokens.css is copied verbatim and never edited. The site adds a place: the page walks down the Ridgeline icon from a dithered dawn sky to the ink foreground, sections grounded on the icon's ridges, seams drawn as dithered canvas ridgelines. Claims are carried by opaque app-sheet mocks that play once in view.
keyCharacteristics: Parent system: Cilica app tokens, springs, glass and icon rules, inherited unchanged.
Light by default in the app icon's colours: warm-white grounds, cream and taupe ridges, the ink base for the close.
Dithered canvas ridgelines are the site's only art.
Colour means what it means in the app: blue is Cilica working, red is recording, amber is Home and the sun, speaker colours are people.
Mocks are opaque sheets. Glass is only for things that float.
Motion uses the app springs. Demos play once in view. Reduced motion and reduced transparency are honoured everywhere.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: A signal colour appears only where its app meaning is true: blue means Cilica is working, red means recording, speaker colours mean a person. If it is not that thing, it is graphite or ink.

rules.name: The Ridges Are Ground Rule
rules.body: Ridge colours paint art and grounds, never buttons, chips or text.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Every heading, label and button is in sentence case. Nothing is uppercase, and no heading has a small label above it.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: There is no serif and no second display face on the site. Newsreader belongs to the app's editor and is not used here.

rules.name: The Glass Floats Rule
rules.body: Glass is only for floating controls: the nav once you scroll, the recorder capsule, toasts, the command palette and the thesaurus popover. Mocks and cards are opaque. Under reduced transparency, glass becomes bg-raised with no blur.

rules.name: The No Inner Light Rule
rules.body: No inset 0 1px 0 highlight and no inner glow on any surface. Cilica's blue glow is outside the element and only appears while Cilica works.

dos: Do treat the Cilica app design system as the parent. Take every app token from tokens.css (copied, never edited), and add site tokens only in site.css.
Do put each section on its band ground in descent order, and set the band's secondary-ink overrides on bands 2 and 3.
Do keep the site light by default; dark only from the footer toggle. Warm whites are the common grounds; cream and taupe for art, ink for the close.
Do show behaviour with an opaque app-sheet mock that plays once in view and lands on its end state under reduced motion.
Do use the app springs for anything that moves, and translate-only reveals.
Do write in sentence case with plain verbs and second person. Call the assistant "Cilica". State facts concretely.

Do keep every shipped raster traceable: og.png and apple-touch-icon.png from scripts/og.ts (SVG in code, Inter OFL); public/logos/* are third-party import-catalogue logos used nominatively; no other rasters ship.
donts: Don't use Cilica blue for anything that isn't Cilica working, red for anything that isn't recording, or speaker colours for anything that isn't a person.
Don't put glass on a mock, card or section. Glass is for floating controls only.
Don't add inner light (inset 0 1px 0 …) or inner glows to any surface.
Don't fade content from zero opacity on reveal, or loop a demo forever.
Don't use ridge colours on controls or text, or add art other than the dithered ridgelines.
Don't use emoji, "Success!", uppercase labels or small labels above headings. Don't call the assistant "AI" outside category or SEO needs.
Don't edit src/styles/tokens.css. Change the app's tokens.json and copy it over.
Don't treat the bouncy-spring overshoot or the shimmer label as defects: both are app presets kept on purpose.
